notes.title: NEW GAME ANNOUNCEMENT: 'Advent: Dawn'—The next in our Sci-fi Mystery Series
notes.content:
[h3]Announcing [i][b]'Advent: Dawn'[/b][/i]—The Next Chapter in Our Sci-fi Visual Novel Series[/h3][p]
We’re excited to share the first look at [b]Advent: Dawn[/b], our upcoming [b]sci-fi mystery visual novel[/b] and the next story set in the same universe as [b]SYNESTHESIA[/b][/p][p]In [b]Advent: Dawn[/b], seven strangers are trapped in a vast underground cave beneath a remote island. With fear mounting and trust breaking apart, they must find a way to escape—or risk becoming part of the cave’s secrets forever.[/p][p]If you enjoyed the storytelling and atmosphere of [b]SYNESTHESIA[/b] we hope you’ll join us for this next adventure. You can check out the Steam page and [b]add it to your wishlist[/b] here:
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3820260/Advent_Dawn/"][/dynamiclink][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3820260/Advent_Dawn/" style="button"]WISHLIST 'Advent: Dawn' HERE![/url][/p][p]Thank you so much for your continued support.[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3820260/Advent_Dawn/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Script Update Fix
notes.content:
We have just updated the game to fix some spelling mistakes and typos, so be sure to update your game.

This occurred because our final proof-read script ended up being overwritten with an older version (very annoyingly) just prior to release. We didn't want to delay the release, as such we have been combing through the game to fix everything back up - this update should fix all that. If you do notice anything that slipped between the cracks free to post it on the community screenshot section, or join the discord and let us know there.

Thank you!

notes.title: "The VII Enigma" Releases January 25th
notes.content:
[h2]Great news, after a lengthy and intense development, the full game will be releasing [b]January 25th![/b][/h2]
[h3][i]The release will also coincide with a [b]20% off sale[/b] for its opening week.[/i][/h3]

Our vision is to provide a truly compelling and meaningful mystery story, one that will stay with you well beyond the completion of the game. We would love to build this community and partnership, as you get to experience The VII Enigma for yourself on its release.

[h3]So we would also love to [b]invite you to join our new discord server and twitter page.[/b][/h3] [i]These are brand new accounts, so we really appreciate you starting to build the community with us from scratch:[/i]

[url=https://discord.gg/8H32pmn69s][img]https://i.postimg.cc/WzKjCsRX/discord-Socials.png[/img][/url]
[url=https://twitter.com/spiregamesco][img]https://i.postimg.cc/hGxr7sPj/twitter-Socials.png[/img][/url]

We cannot wait for you to play the full game, we believe it'll deliver and then some. We look forward to continuing the journey with you all soon.

[i]Spire.[/i]
